name: games-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.2 server for 150+ browser games, professional AI engine analysis (Stockfish/KataGo/YaneuraOu), Japanese learning suite, P2P multiplayer, and adaptive coaching via SEP-1577 sampling

tools.name: new_game
tools.description: Start a new correspondence game (chess/go/shogi). Returns a game_id for subsequent moves and analysis.

tools.name: make_move
tools.description: Record a move in a specific game. Syncs state to Firebase for P2P multiplayer sessions.

tools.name: get_game_state
tools.description: Retrieve the current board position, move history, and status of a game.

tools.name: join_shared_session
tools.description: Join a P2P Firebase session by game_id. Syncs remote move history to local state.

tools.name: get_ai_move
tools.description: Request the next move from the integrated AI engine (Stockfish, KataGo, YaneuraOu) with configurable depth and skill level.

tools.name: analyze_position_detailed
tools.description: Perform deep multi-line position analysis with engine evaluations at configurable depth (default 20 ply).

tools.name: check_engine_health
tools.description: Check status and availability of game engine servers (Stockfish, KataGo, YaneuraOu).

tools.name: create_tournament
tools.description: Create a new tournament with configurable game type, player count, and time control format (blitz/standard/correspondence).

tools.name: register_for_tournament
tools.description: Register a player for a tournament by tournament_id and player_id.

tools.name: get_player_statistics
tools.description: Get comprehensive player statistics including ELO rating, game history, win/loss ratio, and performance metrics.

tools.name: update_player_rating
tools.description: Update a player's ELO rating after a game result (win/loss/draw) using standard ELO calculation.

tools.name: intelligent_game_analysis
tools.description: Orchestrate a comprehensive multi-step AI analysis of a game using SEP-1577 sampling for deep positional understanding.

tools.name: adaptive_learning_session
tools.description: Conduct an adaptive AI-guided training session with personalized exercises based on player history.

tools.name: design_coaching_program
tools.description: Design a multi-week coaching program with adaptive curriculum, tailored to the player's specific strengths and weaknesses.
